core_meaning.primary_meaning: Najah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Success, deliverance”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Najah corresponds to the Arabic form نَجَاح (Arabic root ن ج ح (n-j-ḥ); نَجَاح (Najāḥ)). Its core sense is najaah; success, deliverance. Najah is Arabic نَجَاح (Najāḥ) 'success, deliverance', from the root ن ج ح (n-j-ḥ). The source gloss 'Victory, Triumph' is broadly consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly female. Same name as najaah.
